summary_en: 90,000 shares (1.68% S/O), ¥98.55M upper limit. ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,095 (closing price 2026-06-11). Execution window: 2026-06-12 08:45 JST. Settlement same day. Partial or full non-execution possible due to market conditions.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Fulltech's board approved on 2026-06-11 the acquisition of up to 90,000 treasury shares (1.68% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) with an upper limit of ¥98.55M. The company will execute the purchase via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours auction on 2026-06-12 at 08:45 JST using the prior trading day's closing price of ¥1,095 per share. The order is valid only during the specified trading window and will be matched against sell orders available at that time. The company reserved the right not to execute the purchase in part or in full depending on market conditions. The stated rationale is to pursue agile capital policy in response to changing business conditions, enhance capital efficiency for enterprise value growth, and enrich shareholder returns.
